A delicious, flaky scone recipe bursting with fresh blueberries.

* 1/2 teaspoon salt

* 1 cup fresh blueberries
* 1/2 cup heavy cream
* 1 large egg
* 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
9. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
10. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

data.html_content:
Coded Culinary

Blueberry Scones

A delicious, flaky scone recipe bursting with fresh blueberries.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and shape into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones

These light and flaky blueberry scones are bursting with fresh blueberries and have a delicate lemon glaze.

Preparation time: 15 minutes | Baking time: 20 minutes | Total time: 35 minutes

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Allow to cool before serving.

Nutrition Information

Per scone: 280 calories, 15g fat, 32g carbs, 4g protein

**Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe**

**Ingredients:**
* 2 cups all-purpose flour
* 1/3 cup sugar
* 1 tbsp baking powder
* 1/2 tsp salt
* 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter
* 1 cup fresh blueberries
* 3/4 cup heavy cream
* 1 egg
* 1 tsp vanilla extract

**Instructions:**
1. Mix the dry ingredients together.
2. Cut in the cold butter.
3. Fold in the fresh blueberries.
4. Add the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
5. Shape the dough and cut it into wedges.
6. Bake at 400°F for 18-20 minutes.

**Tips:**
* Keep your ingredients cold.
* Handle the dough gently to ensure flaky scones.
* Brush the scones with cream before baking for a golden finish.

**Serving Suggestions:**
Best served warm with clotted cream or a lemon glaze.
